_comment: JEG-1271 synthetic fixtures. Every player and number is invented. verdict/groups/againstKeys are the outputs of the current trade.js (dealRead, compareTrade, tradeVerdict) on give/receive; tests/test_compare_evidence_view_contract.py recomputes them and fails if they drift. Copy strings are current site text, supplied by the caller; final wording belongs to JEG-1130.

disclosures.summary: What Trade chart average tells you
lines: The mean of the selected, available rescaled chart inputs with complete values for a comparison. Trade readouts need at least three complete inputs. FantasyCalc is eligible alongside USA Today, FantasyPros and CBS. It is an estimate, not a record of what a trade will pay.
The alternate: ESPN, CBS rest of season and Razzball projections, equal weight, averaged for your league.
